title: Trump Weighs Direct US Participation in Saudi Retaliatory Strikes on Houthis
detail: Trump is evaluating direct US participation in Saudi Arabia's retaliatory strikes on Houthis following the deadly Riyadh airport attack, potentially expanding US military involvement in the Yemen theater.

media.caption: Trump evaluates joining Saudi Arabia's strikes on Houthis after Riyadh airport attack

title: Riyadh Airport Death Toll Revised to 12 Killed, 300+ Injured in Houthi Strike
detail: Updated casualty figures from the Houthi missile strike on King Khalid International Airport show at least 12 killed and more than 300 injured — significantly higher than the initial official count of 3 dead. Saudi Arabia extended the airport closure. Multiple major outlets including AP, CBS, and Reuters confirmed the revised toll.

title: Houthis Declare All Saudi Airports Valid Targets Except Sites Near Holy Places
detail: Following the Riyadh airport strike — the deadliest Houthi attack on Saudi soil in a decade — the Houthis announced a new targeting policy declaring all Saudi airports legitimate military targets, with the sole exception of airports near Islamic holy sites. Multiple outlets confirmed the expanded threat posture.

title: Global Condemnation Mounts as Yemen Conflict Expands Beyond Previous Limits
detail: International censure of the Houthi Riyadh airport attack has broadened across world governments. Al Jazeera analysis describes how the Yemen conflict has expanded beyond previous geographic and escalation limits, with strikes on Saudi Arabia's capital marking a qualitative shift in the war's scope.

media.caption: Yemen conflict expands as Houthis attack Riyadh — what to know

title: Saudi Arabia Faces Strategic Dilemma Over Response to Deadliest Houthi Strike in a Decade
detail: Le Monde analysis highlights the difficult position Saudi Arabia faces: intense pressure to retaliate against Houthis after the Riyadh airport attack, the deadliest strike on Saudi territory in a decade, yet serious risks of further escalation if a military response is mounted.

title: Saudi Arabia Vows Major Response to Riyadh Airport Strike; Experts Say Kingdom Will Not Back Down
detail: Saudi Arabia pledged a major retaliatory response following the Houthi missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport that killed 12 and injured 309. Regional analysts stated the kingdom faces immense pressure to act and would not accept the strike without a significant military answer, raising fears of a broader regional escalation.

title: Houthis Claim Strikes on Multiple Saudi Airports and Aramco Oil Facilities
detail: The Houthi movement claimed responsibility for missile and drone strikes on multiple Saudi airports as well as Aramco oil infrastructure, significantly expanding the declared target set beyond aviation to include Saudi Arabia's critical energy sector. The expansion to Aramco facilities marks a major escalation threatening global oil supply chains.
